critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the 'upper deck hump' geometry by extending its longitudinal length along the fuselage axis until it aligns with the rear cockpit bulkhead. Simultaneously, apply a fillet radius of 15% to the junction where the hump meets the main body to smooth the transition. Increase the vertical height at the forward section by 20% and widen the 'forehead' face by 10%, rounding the leading edge to create a continuous curve from the nose.

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck hump ends abruptly near the front of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The hump extends significantly further back along the top of the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length along the longitudinal axis

discrepancies.observed: A sharp, angular transition where the upper deck meets the main body.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous curve blending into the main fuselage.

discrepancies.observed: The hump appears relatively flat and low-profile.
discrepancies.reference: A more pronounced vertical rise from the nose to the top of the cockpit area.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase height at the front section

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck starts immediately above the cockpit windows.
discrepancies.reference: The hump has a distinct rounded 'forehead' shape that integrates with the nose curve.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: round and widen the forward face
